items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: I was very lucky to get to play a lot with Bob Cranshaw for instance and with Frank Wess and with Joe, and those musicians, Clark Terry, those guys, they treated everybody with such dignity and respect.

ctx.x: As someone called it, an “agony stick.”
Well Frank Wess used to have a Christmas card that had him in a Santa Claus suit warming himself over a big fire with a giant smile on his face and in the fire were clarinets and bass clarinets.
Do you have an issue with, first of all with all those horns, you must do a count when you’re getting on the bus or wherever like okay I’ve got the twelve —
